definitions.explanation: A type of battery that uses a paste electrolyte rather than liquid, commonly used in everyday devices like remote controls, flashlights, and toys.

examples.japanese: {乾電池|かんでんち}を{入|い}れ{替|か}える。
{乾電池|かんでんち}が{切|き}れた。
この{懐中電灯|かいちゅうでんとう}は{単三|たんさん}{乾電池|かんでんち}2{本|ほん}で{動|うご}く。
examples.english: This flashlight runs on two AA batteries.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{乾|かん} (dry) + {電池|でんち} (battery)

COMMON SIZES:
- {単一|たんいち}: D size
- {単二|たんに}: C size
- {単三|たんさん}: AA size
- {単四|たんよん}: AAA size
- {単五|たんご}: N size

TYPES:
- アルカリ{乾電池|かんでんち}: alkaline battery
- マンガン{乾電池|かんでんち}: manganese battery

RELATED TERMS:
- {充電池|じゅうでんち}: rechargeable battery
- {電池切|でんちぎ}れ: dead battery
